summary: Keep installer secrets in Ansible Vault: in the setup bundle directory run `ansible-vault create vault.yml`, set a password (needed for backups and reconfigurations too; quote special characters), add the sensitive variables and remove them from the inventory, store the vault password securely, and edit with `ansible-vault edit vault.yml`.
questions: How do I keep AAP installer passwords out of the inventory file?
How do I create a vault file for the AAP installer?
How do I edit the AAP installer vault file?
Do I need the vault password for AAP backups?

answer_card.title: Vault the installer secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd /path/to/ansible-automation-platform-setup-bundle-2.6-<version>
ansible-vault create vault.yml   # set a vault password
ansible-vault edit vault.yml     # later edits
```
Put the passwords in `vault.yml` and delete them from the inventory. Keep the vault password safe: backups and reconfigurations need it.
